title: I’m Fed up!
content:
⭐️ 1 Star — Extremely frustrating experience

I have spent hundreds of credits trying to get Kling to do one very specific thing: use my uploaded photo for the characters and follow the action in my uploaded reference video.

What makes this even more frustrating is that Kling has successfully made three or four videos for me before, ranging from about 10 seconds to 30 seconds long. Those videos came out correctly. I know the feature works. I know what I’m doing. I’m using the same process I’ve successfully used before.

So now I’m trying to make a simple 9-second video, and Kling repeatedly ignores the video reference and does whatever movement it decides to do. In some attempts, it essentially gives me the same image I uploaded instead of following the reference video at all.

I’ve contacted support multiple times through email, the website, the web, and the app. I’ve already gone through the complaint and troubleshooting process repeatedly. Despite all of that, the problem has not been resolved, and I have not been reimbursed for the hundreds of credits used on these failed generations.

I’m not complaining because I expect every generation to be perfect. I understand AI can make mistakes. But I’ve already successfully created three or four videos with Kling using this process. I know it can work, and I know I’m not doing something wrong.

That’s why it’s especially frustrating to keep losing credits on a 9-second video that isn’t even following the reference I’m providing.

I’ve given Kling multiple opportunities to address this through every support channel available to me. At this point, I’m done wasting credits.

I know this feature works. I’ve seen it work. I just want Kling to follow the reference I’m providing instead of doing whatever it wants with my credits.
